sections.heading: C2 — Traffic signal decisions
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Traffic signal decisions

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A02
To travel straight after stopping at red, wait for green and for crossing traffic to clear. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A02
A right turn at red is allowed only after a complete stop, when safe, and when no sign forbids it. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A02
A driver making a permitted right turn at red must watch for pedestrians in front of the vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A02
A flashing red signal requires the same complete stop as a stop sign, followed by travel only when safe. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A02
A red arrow requires stopping and forbids movement in its direction while it remains red. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A02
Movement following a red arrow may begin after it goes out and a green arrow or green light appears. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0007]
